data_on_disk.download_strategy: parallel fetch, ~1-2 MB each, ~10 min for full set

description: Brazos B del cuadro FME: re-analisis cuantitativo-ish de PXD008076 (CSF, 39 FM + 36 HC) via espectral counting sobre los matchs por espectro embebidos en los .mzid, para testar si las cannoneras FME (IL-6/CXCL8/IL1RN/IL1B/TAC1/CA14/eje IFN) separan FM vs HC a nivel proteico en CSF.
hash_method: eidos-canonicalization-v1 (excludes spec_hash and hash_method, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

hypotheses_to_test.H1_cannonera: IL-6 / CXCL8 / IL1RN / IL1B (pro-inflam) show differential spectral counts FM vs HC (direction unknown, blunted = DOWN in FM)
hypotheses_to_test.H2_ca14: CA14 (CAR14) presence frequency differs FM vs HC (nominal 3/5 vs 1/5 from earlier 5+5 sample)
hypotheses_to_test.H3_ifn: IFN-axis proteins (ISG15, IFIT1, MX1, OAS1) show differential presence

kill_criterion.fail_if: No protein of the cannon/IFN axis passes FDR < 0.10 in n=75 → linea proteica cerrada sin ambigüedad (reanálisis cuantitativo no rescata la señal)
kill_criterion.metric: at least 1 of the 3 hypothesis-groups (H1 cannonera, H2 CA14, H3 IFN) showing differential spectral presence with BH-FDR corrected p < 0.10 across full n=75
kill_criterion.threshold: BH-FDR < 0.10 on cannon/CA14/IFN genes with consistent direction

method.comparison: Mann-Whitney U / Fisher-based presence-frequency FM vs HC on common proteins
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR<0.05 on the ~2000 proteins per group
method.normalization: Pascal's triangle-style NSAF (normalized spectral abundance factor)
method.quantification: Spectral counting (peptide-spectrum matches per protein per sample)
